title: RecipeTin's Three Cup Chicken
ingredients: 1.5 tbsp canola oil & 1.5 tbsp toasted sesame oil
6 ginger slices (3mm thick) & 1.5 tbsp minced garlic
2 dried red chillies & 1 cup Thai basil leaves
Sauce: 2 tbsp light soy, 2 tsp dark soy, 2 tsp sugar, 2 tbsp cooking wine
steps: Heat oil in a non-stick pan over medium-low, add ginger and chillies, and stir for 30 seconds.
Turn heat to high, add chicken, and stir until surface turns white but is still raw inside.
Add garlic and stir for another 30 seconds before pouring in the prepared sauce mixture.
Simmer on medium-high for 5 minutes, stirring frequently until the sauce reduces to a thin syrup.
Stir in sesame oil and Thai basil leaves, cooking for 15 seconds until wilted, then serve over rice.
